mechanism.claim: when BVOL and DVOL reprice in opposite directions and Deribit has the larger normalized body, an extreme first-half BTC shock followed by same-direction flow at no more than half the magnitude identifies price impact exhaustion under options-market leadership
mechanism.side: opposite sign of first-half BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: DLSDR replaces CVSDR absolute-OI tail confirmation with Deribit normalized-body leadership and does not require CVDAR opposite-direction absorption
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the clock is anchored to cross-venue options leadership plus an intrahour impact-decay path absent from Gross9

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.volatility: BVOL and DVOL normalized bodies have opposite nonzero signs and abs(DVOL body)>abs(BVOL body)
clock.price_source: 60 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [T-1h,T), split at exact minute 30
clock.first_half_shock: nonzero absolute first-half return >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 observations
clock.deceleration: second-half return has the same nonzero sign and absolute magnitude <= one half of first-half absolute return
clock.funding: not a signal input; opened only for later exact PnL accounting
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset, prior hour source-valid and consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, all features available by T
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR
